name: Wrightworks Guild
specialty: Salvage rights, part discounts, and the best mechanics in any hall.
culture: Wage floors and mandatory rest — genuinely good for the crew, and it costs you. Solidarity calls are expected to be answered.
playsLike: Tinkerer. Poorer, slower, the best-maintained ship in the system, and crew who stay for decades.

name: Helios Combine
specialty: Huge cargo contracts and cheap fuel at company ports.
culture: Schedule discipline and late-delivery penalties. Morale drags in a company town.
playsLike: Logistics optimisation. Big margins, tight deadlines, replaceable people — and the temptation that comes with treating them that way.

name: Meridian Institute
specialty: Survey contracts, sensor tech, astrogation training.
culture: Data must be shared. Low pay, high tech access.
playsLike: The long game. Bad money, unmatched tech and training, missions that go further out than anyone else's.

name: The Drift
specialty: Grey market, no questions asked, the best margins going.
culture: No safety net, no insurance, no death benefit. Standing is personal and fragile.
playsLike: High risk. Best pay, worst consequences, and the only guild where your crew might be running from something.
